# Engine marks

These are the original vendor assets used on Terrence's README illustration.
`../EngineMarks.tsx` preserves their path geometry, view boxes, and colors while
resolving presentation styles to inline SVG fills. The orbit scene scales the
marks proportionally without background tiles or overlapping paws.

- Terraform: HashiCorp Design System, `packages/flight-icons/svg/terraform-color-24.svg`,
  revision `83cac84fdfca82148176f2535a198a6a6be26dbb`.
  [Source](https://github.com/hashicorp/design-system/blob/83cac84fdfca82148176f2535a198a6a6be26dbb/packages/flight-icons/svg/terraform-color-24.svg).
  License: [LICENSE-HashiCorp](LICENSE-HashiCorp).
- OpenTofu: `brand-artifacts`, `symbol-only/transparent/SVG/on-light.svg`,
  revision `589e4111bcf8de39fae9dfb2b8659f7f5373a92b`.
  [Source](https://github.com/opentofu/brand-artifacts/blob/589e4111bcf8de39fae9dfb2b8659f7f5373a92b/symbol-only/transparent/SVG/on-light.svg).
  License: [LICENSE-OpenTofu](LICENSE-OpenTofu).
